figures.title: Adrenal gland: CYP17A1 immunohistochemistry
figures.caption: Adrenal gland tissue stained for cytochrome P450 family 17 subfamily A member 1 (CYP17A1). Brown: CYP17A1 protein. Blue: cell nuclei (hematoxylin counterstain).
figures.alt: Microscope image of adrenal gland tissue with CYP17A1 protein stained brown and cell nuclei stained blue.
figures.credit: Image from the Human Protein Atlas 25.1 (proteinatlas.org): CYP17A1 immunohistochemistry in adrenal gland, https://images.proteinatlas.org/ih_additional_tissue/48533/417_227.jpg. CC BY 4.0.
